name: forgeguard
description: AI-native release and incident commander built on Cloudflare Workers, Agents, Workflows and Workers AI

scripts.dev: npm run cf-typegen && npm run build:dashboard && npm run db:migrate:local && concurrently -n worker,dashboard -c blue,magenta "wrangler dev --local" "vite dev --config apps/dashboard/vite.config.ts"
scripts.dev:worker-only: npm run cf-typegen && npm run build:dashboard && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --local
scripts.typecheck: npm run cf-typegen && sleep 1 && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json --noEmit
